ServerManifest.Name: Free Realms Evergrove
ServerManifest.Description:
**Welcome to Free Realms Evergrove!** Creative housing with 1,700+ free building pieces, free lots, and friends to visit.
New here? Register with the button under the login form, then press **Play**. The first Play downloads the official Free Realms game (about 850 MB) unless you choose a game folder you already have with the **+** button.
